title: Silas and the Echo
author: Jude Delacroix
blurb: Zephyrine Thackeray, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
